sn51.18:1.1: “Bhikkhus, by developing and cultivating the four bases of psychic power, a bhikkhu realizes the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom in this very life. And they live having realized it with their own insight due to the destruction of defilements.
sn51.18:2.2: It’s when a bhikkhu develops the basis of psychic power that has concentration due to enthusiasm …
